pages.text: $(l)Oakskin$()$(br)The Eye of the Sleepless Witness defensive state. Active while you're on the ground, not sprinting, and barely moving. Gives $(thing)Resistance$() and reveals monsters from farther away.
$(l)Penance$()$(br)Chain of the Penitent stores part of the damage you take as Penance. Your next direct melee hit spends it as bonus damage and makes the target $(thing)glow$().
$(l)Desperate Want$()$(br)Covetfang at low health. If something stronger is nearby, you heal on hit and move faster. If not, the weapon gets weaker and slower.

$(l)Over-Enchants$()$(br)While Branded, enchanting power can go above 30. Enchantments that roll at max level can go one level higher, such as Protection V or Unbreaking IV. Over-level enchants show in light purple.
